uncited: It sets itself apart from the [Absorption-only model](839-absorption-only-model.md) by including in-scattering, and from the full [Radiative Transfer Equation Formulation](1194-radiative-transfer-equation-formulation.md) by truncating the scattering series after the first order, thereby enabling faster computation at the cost of accuracy in dense media.
Sabella introduced a ray-casting method that uses an accurate light-scattering model to model the scattering effects of light in a cloud.
